objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: layunin at saklaw ng uhc.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: uhc purpose and coverage.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig muna sa tanong bago magpaliwanag o mangako.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen to the question before explaining or promising anything.

sections.takeaway_fil: Layunin ng UHC ang mas madaling paglapit sa dekalidad na serbisyo at proteksiyon sa gastusin.
sections.takeaway_en: UHC aims to improve access to quality care and protect people from financial hardship.

sections.takeaway_fil: Awtomatikong kasama sa NHIP ang bawat Pilipinong mamamayan.
sections.takeaway_en: Every Filipino citizen is automatically included in the NHIP.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pagiging kasama sa programa ay hindi pangakong libre ang bawat serbisyo saanman.
sections.takeaway_en: Inclusion in the program is not a promise that every service is free everywhere.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang benepisyo, provider, at kailangang hakbang para sa partikular na konsulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Check the benefit, provider, and required steps for the particular consultation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ibigay ang alam na, at tukuyin ang dapat pang tiyakin.
sections.takeaway_en: Explain what is known and name what still needs checking.

check.prompt_fil: Kung kasama na si Mang Ernesto sa PhilHealth, libre na ba ang konsulta niya sa kahit aling pasilidad? Ano ang dapat sabihin ni Vlanche?
check.prompt_en: If Mang Ernesto is already included in PhilHealth, is his consultation free at any facility? What should Vlanche say?

options.fil: Kasama kayo sa PhilHealth. Tiyakin natin kung sakop ang konsultang ito rito, kung sino ang provider, at ang kailangang hakbang.
options.en: You are included in PhilHealth. Let us check whether this consultation is covered here, who the provider is, and what steps apply.

options.fil: Oo. Dahil kasama kayo, libre ang lahat ng konsulta sa kahit aling pasilidad.
options.en: Yes. Because you are included, all consultations at every facility are free.

options.fil: Hindi mahalaga ang UHC; walang maaaring saklaw na konsulta.
options.en: UHC makes no difference; no consultation can be covered.

check.feedback_fil: Awtomatikong kasama si Mang Ernesto sa NHIP, ngunit hindi iyon sagot sa sakop ng partikular na konsulta. Tiyakin ang benepisyo, provider, at proseso bago mangako ng walang bayad.
check.feedback_en: Mang Ernesto is automatically included in the NHIP, but that alone does not settle coverage for this consultation. Check the benefit, provider, and process before promising no charge.
